:::note[Written against main]
This page follows `main` at cbe2c19, and it differs from the copy in HotLoop Cascade 0.1.2, the latest release. Parts of it may be newer than what you have installed. The [release notes](/releases/) say what moved.
:::

You need Go 1.27.1.

```sh
make build        # bin/hotloop-cascade
make image        # the container image, with Podman
test/run.sh       # vet and every test with -race, against real services
```

The tests run against real services, never mocks. `test/services/up.sh` starts
them in Podman on a network of their own (Postgres, Hydra, a headless Chrome,
Mosquitto, a HotLoop gateway, ntfy, Gotify, a mail server, ERPNext, OpenLDAP and a Samba Active Directory controller), and `test/run.sh` runs the suite in a `golang` container on
that network. CI runs the same two scripts. A test whose service is missing
fails instead of skipping, because a skipped integration test is a test that
never ran. `test/services/down.sh` cleans up, and it only ever touches
containers it made.

The database is a setting. `HOTLOOP_CASCADE_DATABASE` is `sqlite:<path>` (the
default, under `HOTLOOP_CASCADE_DATA_DIR`) or a `postgres://` URL, and every
store test runs against both.

No Docker and no Compose. Cascade ships for Podman (with Quadlet) and for k3s
(with Helm).
